primary_research_source.title: Kaminski and Lo, When Do Stop-Loss Rules Stop Losses?
primary_research_source.limited_inference: Stop-loss value depends on the price process; a random-walk result does not promise improvement, while serial dependence can make exit rules informative. The paper does not establish the proposed hashed-entry H4 strategy or any profitable parameter.
